verdict.rationale: Billing terms are a fair question for a SaaS issue tracker like Linear, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no pricing-page or billing documentation saying whether plans enforce a minimum seat count or require an annual commitment. The only billing-adjacent items are that agents are not billable users, that the free plan is capped at 250 issues, and that guest accounts are priced as full users; none of these answers the minimum-seat or annual-commitment question.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know whether my plan enforces a minimum seat count or annual billing commitment before I subscribe
